execution: Parent only, through the new azure-final-arm.mjs; no requests have been made for this plan.

bindings.COMM_ID: Exact parent-allowlisted ARM resource ID ending /Microsoft.Communication/communicationServices/ori-12week-comm; do not guess its resource group.
bindings.EMAIL_ID: Exact parent-allowlisted ARM resource ID ending /Microsoft.Communication/emailServices/ori-12week-email; do not discover other resources.
bindings.DOMAIN_ID: Existing child of EMAIL_ID returned by domains-list, with properties.fromSenderDomain exactly equal to intendedDomain.
bindings.CURRENT_SENDER_ID: Existing child of DOMAIN_ID returned by senders-list whose properties.username matches the effective working EMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS local part.
bindings.DESIRED_SENDER_ID: Existing child of DOMAIN_ID returned by senders-list whose properties.username is exactly 12wyapp.

evidenceStatus.providerConfiguration: Not yet observed. No downloaded ACS domain or sender-username configuration was found in this local handoff. The intended address is a request, not a verified sender.
evidenceStatus.appContract: server/src/config.ts reads ACS_EMAIL_CONNECTION_STRING and EMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS from the environment; default dotenv loading does not override existing process environment.
evidenceStatus.sdkContract: Installed @azure/communication-email EmailMessage has senderAddress:string, not a sender displayName field. Do not inject a From header or place '12WY <address>' in senderAddress.

projectionPolicy.persistOnly: HTTP status, fixed request label, and explicitly allowed projected fields below. Validate scalar types and bound strings and arrays.
neverPersist: response headers or signed operation URLs
systemData, tags, identities, or unrelated properties
raw environment files or process environments
projectionPolicy.errorProjection: HTTP status plus error.code only when it matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,80}$; otherwise a fixed generic code.
projectionPolicy.pagination: Record hasMore:boolean only. Do not follow nextLink. Incomplete or oversized results mean retain the working sender, not broaden discovery.
projectionPolicy.resourceIds: Accept only exact approved resource IDs or strict descendants of the approved EMAIL_ID; never follow an arbitrary returned URL.

initialRequests.purpose: Confirm the existing communication resource and its linked email-domain IDs. No listKeys.
Find only the requested existing domain and establish managed/custom status, provisioning and verification. Never create, verify, relink, or alter a domain.
Observe the real allowed MailFrom username resources and existing display names. Do not confuse mailFromSenderDomain (envelope domain) with a selectable username.

selectionRules: Require complete, successful reads and the exact requested domain linked to COMM_ID. Reject ambiguous domain/sender matches.
Parent's separately approved VM preflight must establish the effective working sender for the app and existing workers without printing credentials. Do not assume the default username or casing.

Changing the app address requires the desired sender to ALREADY exist in G3, its username to be 12wyapp, the requested domain to be provisioned Succeeded and verified, and DOMAIN_ID to be linked in G1.
If a sender-level provisioningState exists, it must be Succeeded; absence is not invented as a success state. A successful post-write GET of the configured username is still required.

If domainManagement is AzureManaged and 12wyapp is absent, there is no positive configuration evidence permitting a custom MailFrom. Do not attempt speculative creation. Retain the working sender and attempt only its supported displayName update.
This plan does not create 12wyapp even when an unrelated custom-domain capability might exist. No new domain, resource, DNS change, key operation, From-header spoofing, or paid feature is permitted.
If provider support remains unknown, leave the working sender unchanged. Existing in-message 12WY branding remains available; report that a mailbox display-name change was not verified.

writes.selection: DESIRED_SENDER_ID only if all address-change gates pass; otherwise CURRENT_SENDER_ID. Skip if the existing displayName is already exactly 12WY.
writes.bodyPolicy: Only these two properties. Preserve the observed username and resource ID exactly. Never send the full email address as username.
writes.precondition: The selected resource must exist in G3. This is an in-place sender metadata update, not an upsert to an unobserved username.

Optional only when W1 targeted a distinct, pre-existing desired sender but was rejected or could not be confirmed, and the working sender needs display branding. Never repeat a failed write to the same resource. Never change the working username.

confirmationRequests.require: Exact expected resource/username and displayName 12WY. Do not treat HTTP 202 or an unverified PUT response as permission to install an address override.

confirmationRequests.when: Only to verify W2, or to confirm that the retained sender remains unchanged after an inconclusive W1.
Reserve for one delayed fixed-resource confirmation if an earlier GET was not yet conclusive. No unbounded polling or operation-URL following. If still inconclusive, retain the current address.

minimumBudget: Usually 3 initial GETs + 1 displayName PUT + 1 confirmation GET. Already-correct observed branding can need no write. Unused permission is not a requirement to send more requests.

conditionalVmInstall.neededOnlyWhen: The desired pre-existing sender passes all positive provider gates, is confirmed after branding, and differs from the effective working sender.
conditionalVmInstall.ownershipAndMode: root:root 0600, regular single-link file; reject symlinks and unexpected existing content.
conditionalVmInstall.environmentOrder: Preserve every approved existing EnvironmentFile entry. Keep credentials and public MVP settings; append the sender-only EnvironmentFile last for each existing app/email-worker service. Do not clear the EnvironmentFile list, copy secrets into the public file, or override NODE_ENV/DATA_DIR/DB_FILE/APP_PUBLIC_URL/approved IDs.
conditionalVmInstall.activation: Parent may incorporate the returned drop-in fragment in the separately reviewed final release. No worker start/restart or timer trigger. daemon-reload alone does not restart running jobs. Workers adopt it on their next normal approved invocation; the app adopts it at its separately approved final-release restart, after in-flight activity is handled by that release plan.
conditionalVmInstall.fallback: If retaining the current address, do not install any sender override or new service drop-in. A supported provider displayName change requires no application restart.
conditionalVmInstall.verification: Report only booleans for credential presence, desired-sender match, effective file order, approved public settings unchanged and service state. No environment dumps, test mail, provider send call or credential output.

handoff: Fresh narrow parent review is required before any plan/helper execution. No tests, code execution, network requests, VM access, credentials-file reads, email sends, or deployment were performed for this source-only preparation.
